import re

def compare_versions(a, b):
    # Regular expression to validate version strings
    version_pattern = r'^(\d+)\.(\d+)\.(\d+)$'
    
    # Validate both version strings
    if not re.match(version_pattern, a) or not re.match(version_pattern, b):
        raise ValueError("Invalid version string format")
    
    # Split version strings into components
    a_parts = list(map(int, a.split('.')))
    b_parts = list(map(int, b.split('.')))
    
    # Compare each component
    for a_part, b_part in zip(a_parts, b_parts):
        if a_part < b_part:
            return -1
        elif a_part > b_part:
            return 1
    
    # If all components are equal
    return 0

import unittest
from brackets import *

class TestBrackets(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_empty_string(self):
        self.assertTrue(is_balanced(""))

    def test_single_pair(self):
        self.assertTrue(is_balanced("()"))
        self.assertTrue(is_balanced("[]"))
        self.assertTrue(is_balanced("{}"))

    def test_multiple_pairs(self):
        self.assertTrue(is_balanced("()[]{}"))
        self.assertTrue(is_balanced("({[()]})"))
        self.assertTrue(is_balanced("({[()]})({[()]})"))

    def test_unbalanced_brackets(self):
        self.assertFalse(is_balanced("(]"))
        self.assertFalse(is_balanced("([)]"))
        self.assertFalse(is_balanced("{[]}"))
        self.assertFalse(is_balanced("([)]"))
        self.assertFalse(is_balanced("((()))"))
        self.assertFalse(is_balanced("((())"))
        self.assertFalse(is_balanced("())"))
        self.assertFalse(is_balanced("({[()]})("))
        self.assertFalse(is_balanced("({[()]})"))
        self.assertFalse(is_balanced("({[()]})"))
        self.assertFalse(is_balanced("({[()]})"))

import unittest
from minstack import MinStack

class TestMinStack(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_push(self):
        stack = MinStack()
        stack.push(1)
        self.assertEqual(stack.stack, [1])
        self.assertEqual(stack.min_stack, [1])

    def test_pop(self):
        stack = MinStack()
        stack.push(1)
        stack.push(2)
        self.assertEqual(stack.pop(), 2)
        self.assertEqual(stack.stack, [1])
        self.assertEqual(stack.min_stack, [1])

    def test_top(self):
        stack = MinStack()
        stack.push(1)
        stack.push(2)
        self.assertEqual(stack.top(), 2)
        self.assertEqual(stack.stack, [1, 2])
        self.assertEqual(stack.min_stack, [1, 1])

    def test_get_min(self):
        stack = MinStack()
        stack.push(1)
        stack.push(2)
        self.assertEqual(stack.get_min(), 1)
        self.assertEqual(stack.stack, [1, 2])
        self.assertEqual(stack.min_stack, [1, 1])

    def test_push_multiple(self):
        stack = MinStack()
        stack.push(3)
        stack.push(5)
        stack.push(2)
        self.assertEqual(stack.stack, [3, 5, 2])
        self.assertEqual(stack.min_stack, [3, 3, 2])

    def test_pop_multiple(self):
        stack = MinStack()
        stack.push(3)
        stack.push(5)
        stack.push(2)
        stack.pop()
        self.assertEqual(stack.stack, [3, 5])
        self.assertEqual(stack.min_stack, [3, 3])

    def test_get_min_after_push_multiple(self):
        stack = MinStack()
        stack.push(3)
        stack.push(5)
        stack.push(2)
        self.assertEqual(stack.get_min(), 2)
        self.assertEqual(stack.stack, [3, 5, 2])
        self.assertEqual(stack.min_stack, [3, 3, 2])

    def test_top_after_push_multiple(self):
        stack = MinStack()
        stack.push(3)
        stack.push(5)
        stack.push(2)
        self.assertEqual(stack.top(), 2)
        self.assertEqual(stack.stack, [3, 5, 2])
        self.assertEqual(stack.min_stack, [3, 3, 2])

    def test_pop_from_empty_stack(self):
        stack = MinStack()
        with self.assertRaises(IndexError):
            stack.pop()

    def test_top_from_empty_stack(self):
        stack = MinStack()
        with self.assertRaises(IndexError):
            stack.top()

    def test_get_min_from_empty_stack(self):
        stack = MinStack()
        with self.assertRaises(IndexError):
            stack.get_min()

if __name__ == '__main__':

class TestMinStack(unittest.TestCase):

        stack = MinStack()

        self.assertEqual(stack.stack, [3])
        self.assertEqual(stack.min_stack, [3])
        stack.push(5)
        self.assertEqual(stack.stack, [3, 5])
        self.assertEqual(stack.min_stack, [3, 3])
        stack.push(2)
        self.assertEqual(stack.stack, [3, 5, 2])
        self.assertEqual(stack.min_stack, [3, 3, 2])
        stack.push(1)
        self.assertEqual(stack.stack, [3, 5, 2, 1])
        self.assertEqual(stack.min_stack, [3, 3, 2, 1])

    def test_pop(self):
        stack = MinStack()
        stack.push(3)
        stack.push(5)
        stack.push(2)
        stack.push(1)
        self.assertEqual(stack.pop(), 1)
        self.assertEqual(stack.stack, [3, 5, 2])
        self.assertEqual(stack.min_stack, [3, 3, 2])
        self.assertEqual(stack.pop(), 2)
        self.assertEqual(stack.stack, [3, 5])
        self.assertEqual(stack.min_stack, [3, 3])
        self.assertEqual(stack.pop(), 5)
        self.assertEqual(stack.stack, [3])
        self.assertEqual(stack.min_stack, [3])
        self.assertEqual(stack.pop(), 3)
        self.assertEqual(stack.stack, [])
        self.assertEqual(stack.min_stack, [])

        stack.push(3)
        stack.push(5)

        stack.pop()
        self.assertEqual(stack.top(), 2)
        stack.pop()
        self.assertEqual(stack.top(), 5)
        stack.pop()
        self.assertEqual(stack.top(), 3)
